summary: W3 AlembicAgent producer for alembic-mainbody-lifecycle-adaptation-2026-06-26 §4b(E1-E3) moduleMining fan-out support. W2 is accepted; W3 depends on C mode and Core U2 coverage ledger (already base dependency). Implement only AlembicAgent module-mining producer surfaces needed by Alembic main W3 consumer: add projectContextModules partitioner in AgentRunCoordinator that reads params.modules (not dimensions), yields one child per module with moduleId/moduleName/ownedFiles/phase module-mining-child, and throws on empty modules; add module-mining-session/module-mining-dimension profile(s) with fanout strategy/partitioner/merge and bounded concurrency; add/export runModuleMining({modules, projectFacts, budget, scaleCap}) that applies scaleCap before child creation and preserves full per-child analyst budget semantics (do not divide budget by module count). Preserve PD-3 profile-only/no new Plan capability, PD-8 scale as module count cap not token floor replacement, R5 no reuse of moduleSeeds as fan-out source, no repository/ledger/sharedState writes. Do not edit Alembic, AlembicCore, AlembicPlugin, vendor, schema, or public contracts outside AlembicAgent intended exports. Validate Node>=22 build/typecheck/lint/public-api boundary, focused tests for 3 modules -> 3 children with no dimension cross, empty modules throw, 8 modules + scaleCap 3 -> exactly 3 children each full budget, and exports available to Alembic main. Commit on AlembicAgent main and return commit hash, changed files, validations, raw evidence, and residual risks.
